verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents its own Callback feature: you supply a callback URL and transcription results are delivered there, so pre-recorded jobs need no polling. The evidence is a single thin doc line. It says nothing about failure notifications, retries, payload signing or verification, or which job types support callbacks. Missing for 10: documented callback on job failure, retry/delivery guarantees, callback authentication/signature verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll

citations.quote: Deepgram's Callback feature allows you to supply a callback URL to which transcriptions can be returned.
